_comment: Scenario: UC-01 fatigue/drowsiness with staged recovery options.
Feature 009 (signal-tier redesign): rewritten from the old
behaviour model (steering/pedal/lane/ADAS) is retired; the attention signal
is retired. Drowsiness/fatigue are deterministic Tier-3a signals;
anomaly_rate is the seeded-stochastic Tier-3b signal (the only randomness
in the simulation, seeded by run_seed).
Recovery options (recovery_model gives each activity's fixed drowsiness/fatigue
recovery, applied once per activity — no short/long rest distinction):
nap_karaoke        — wakefulness (MOVING) -> nap/sleep 3 ticks -> karaoke 3 ticks
postpone           — postpone=true, no stages (acts as continue driving)
allowed_actions includes decline in addition to accept_rest/postpone.
